<b>Cloaks of the Choir</b> is a [[Hunt Wishes|Hunt Wish]] in <i>[[Hollow Knight: Silksong]]</i>, started from the Wishwall in [[Songclave]].

== Wish ==
[[File:Choir Cloak.png|link=Choir Cloak|left|thumb|100x100px]]

The residents of Songclave request 16 [[Choir Cloak]]s from Choirbugs in the [[Choral Chambers]]. They can be obtained from [[Choir Pouncer]]s, [[Choir Hornhead]]s, [[Choir Flyer]]s, and [[Choir Elder]]s.

If [[Broodfeast]]/[[Runtfeast]] is active, defeating enemies with the [[Sawtooth Circlet]] will cause them to drop shredded organs instead of cloaks. However, defeating enemies with red tools or the [[Wispfire Lantern]] will cause them to drop both cloaks and the relevant organs. Once 35 shredded organs have been collected, defeating enemies with the Sawtooth Circlet can be used to collect cloaks again.

== Reward ==
[[File:Heavy Rosary Necklace.png|link=Heavy Rosary Necklace|left|thumb|100x100px]]

After completing the quest, a [[Heavy Rosary Necklace]] is rewarded, worth {{R|220}}. A clothesline draped with Choir Cloaks is added to the background in Songclave.
